#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

vector<long long> divisors(long long n) {
    set<long long> ans;
    for (long long i = 1; i * i <= n; ++i) {
        if (n % i == 0) {
            ans.insert(i);
            ans.insert(n / i);
        }
    }
    vector<long long> result(ans.begin(), ans.end());
    sort(result.begin(), result.end());
    return result;
}

int main() {
    const long long mod = 1000000007;
    long long p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

    auto mod_pow = [](long long base, long long exp, long long modulus) {
        long long result = 1 % modulus;
        long long cur = base % modulus;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if (exp & 1) result = (result * cur) % modulus;
            cur = (cur * cur) % modulus;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    };

    if (k == 0) {
        cout << mod_pow(p, p - 1, mod) << "\n";
    } else if (k == 1) {
        cout << mod_pow(p, p, mod) << "\n";
    } else {
        vector<long long> divs = divisors(p - 1);
        for (auto z : divs) {
            if (((p - 1) % z == 0) && (mod_pow(k, z, p) == 1)) {
                cout << mod_pow(p, (p - 1) / z, mod) << "\n";
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
